step1.title: The Foundation
step1.desc: Marrakech was founded by Youssef Ibn Tachfine, leader of the Almoravid dynasty. He chose this strategic location as a gateway to the Sahara and a trading hub between Africa and Europe.

step2.title: Almoravid Era
step2.desc: Marrakech became a powerful capital and a global commercial center for gold, salt, and spices, blending cultures from Africa and Andalusia.

step3.title: Almohad Era
step3.desc: Significant progress was made. Construction of the Koutoubia Mosque, expansion of the city, and development of architecture.

step4.title: The Merinids
step4.desc: The capital moved to Fez, and political importance decreased, but the city remained a vital commercial and economic center.

step5.title: The Saadians
step5.desc: Marrakech flourished again. Construction of the Saadian Tombs, development of palaces, and prosperous trade with Africa.

step6.title: The Alaouites
step6.desc: Stability continued. Marrakech evolved into a global historic city and a world-class tourism hub.

step7.title: Contemporary Marrakech
step7.desc: Marrakech today is a unique blend of history, culture, and modern tourism.

mission.title: Our Vision for Marrakech
mission.desc: To lead the digital renaissance of Marrakech hospitality, making it the most technologically advanced and traditionally preserved destination in the world. We unify local expertise with global standards for an unforgettable journey.
